scope: All 30 frozen questions in all three conditions; no selection or reruns. No paid judge or reference injection into tested agents.

labels.correct: The delivered answer resolves the requested core conditions and independently fetched public evidence confirms all core factual claims.
labels.incorrect: At least one material core assertion or explicit requested condition is contradicted by independent evidence. Record exact numeric mismatches even if small, with minor_numeric severity when appropriate.
labels.unverifiable: A factual answer exists but independent public evidence is incomplete, inaccessible, conflicting, temporally ambiguous, or cannot establish a required condition. Uncertainty is not falsehood.
labels.no_factual_answer: No substantive answer to the requested core question was delivered; explicit inability to establish a fact is not a correct positive answer.

precedence: Confirmed core contradiction > unresolved core evidence > all core claims confirmed. No answer remains no_factual_answer. Peripheral errors never silently change core grading.

dimensions.technical_failure: Separate from accuracy; keep every attempted trial in denominator.
dimensions.delivery_defects: Missing direct video links, creator, duration, promised but absent information, or unsuitable voice presentation are separately recorded. If video existence/creator/topic itself is unestablished, core accuracy is unverifiable.
dimensions.ancillary_errors: Non-core volunteered claims and minor exact numeric mismatches are explicitly identified.

question_criteria: Use exact question and checks in config/full_comparison_v9.json; 2026 dates, explicit trading session/currency/instrument, indoor rather than terrace, own rather than nearby public parking, Saturday 09:00 and bookstore at 22:00 are binding.
sources: Fetch originals/public pages now with URL, timestamp, content SHA256 and short excerpts. Old runs are URL leads only, never evidence. Official effective-date conflict stays uncertain unless resolved. Public fetch failure is not proof of nonexistence. No images, no video-watched claim from metadata.
finance: Use historical regular-session close for specified date, not live/after-hours quote; USD/KRW named institution daily central rate, not spot. Exact numeric comparison with disclosed rounding.
news: Validate article publication 2026-09-02 through 09-08 inclusive when requested, independently of event/effective dates.
videos: Validate watch URL and creator/title/topic from public metadata; chapter/content claims require actual evidence. Missing metadata does not establish global absence.
aggregation: Primary accuracy confirmed-correct / all 30 per condition. Publish four labels and technical failures. Token unknown is never zero. Paired usable-usage/completion subsets and denominators explicit. No claim of product-wide causality or statistical significance.
